title: SRO Finding
description: A finding is the pairing of a researcher's hypothesis with a verifier's verdict. The researcher cannot set a status of CONFIRMED: the separation is enforced in code, not by asking an agent to behave differently.

status.description: 'hypothesis' is where every finding starts. Only a verifier verdict moves it.

expected_evidence.description: What the researcher expects to observe. Written down in advance so a post-hoc rationalisation is visible.

scope_verdict.description: Deterministic scope verdict for the target at verification time.

cited.description: Evidence ids. A CONFIRMED verdict with an empty list is impossible: the store rejects it.

severity.description: Researcher-stated. SRO does not infer severity from evidence.

reported.description: Always false. SRO has no submission capability; disclosure is the researcher's own act.
